payload.reason: The evidence discusses the use of manual Pyramid scores in evaluating summarization metrics, indicating that these scores are derived from human-written summaries and are compared with other metrics like ROUGE.

claims.text: Manual Pyramid scores are used to evaluate the effectiveness of summarization metrics by comparing them with automatic evaluation metrics.
The Pyramid scoring involves organizing content units from gold human-written summaries into a pyramid structure.
Different variants of ROUGE show varying correlations with manual Pyramid scores, indicating the complexity of evaluation metrics.
